title: Shrimp Bake
description: A simple and flavorful shrimp bake recipe that's perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine shrimp, flaky butter, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place the shrimp mixture onto the cut bread pieces, making sure to leave a small border around each piece.
Sprinkle shredded cheese over the shrimp.
Transfer the bread pieces to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Sprinkle dried parsley over the top and serve hot.
